title: National Love People Day and one small kindness for tomorrow
dek: National Love People Day is September 30, and the quiet hour tonight is a good time to plan one small, kind thing for someone tomorrow.
keywords: ways to show people you care
body: September 30 is National Love People Day, a day meant to encourage people to lift each other up. It is a simple idea, and at one in the morning, when things are quiet, it feels like a good thing to think about.

When you picture the people in your life, you may notice how often you think kind things about them without ever saying them out loud. Maybe a coworker handled a hard meeting well. Maybe a neighbor has a lovely garden. Maybe a friend has been carrying a lot lately. Those thoughts tend to stay in our heads, and the other person never hears them.

Loving people can be as simple as paying attention. It looks like remembering what someone told you last week and asking how it went. It looks like holding the door, letting someone merge, or sending a short message that says you were thinking of them.
It helps to include people we do not know, too. The cashier, the bus driver, and the person answering the phone at the doctor's office all have long days too, and a little patience goes a long way.
Before you fall asleep, choose one person and one kind sentence you will say to them tomorrow. Then make sure you actually say it.
